import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 充值信息指令
 * 展示所有充值套餐、货币说明、VIP 体系等信息
 * 数据从 DB 读取，保证与后台配置一致
 */
import { getRechargeInfoData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/info/app';
import { getBackendRealmAccess } from '@src/api/bot/realm-access-queries';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const result = await getRechargeInfoData(uid, isPrivate, bid);

    if (result.code === 'PRIVATE_ONLY') {
      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '充值',
          content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 为了保护您的账号安全，活动充值相关信息仅在私聊中展示，请私聊发送指令查看')
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'FAILED') {
      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '充值',
          content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 读取充值信息失败，请稍后重试')
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    // ── 普通充值 ──
    md.addBold('🧴 普通充值');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('普通充值仅走常规充值规则，不触发限时活动临时套餐逻辑。'));

    if (result.normalPackages.length > 0) {
      for (const pkg of result.normalPackages) {
        md.addBlockquote(
          addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${pkg.name} (${pkg.yuan}¥${pkg.doubleText}${pkg.limitText}) `), [
            { label: '购买', command: `/充值购买 ${pkg.id}` }
          ])
        );

        if (pkg.description) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${pkg.description}`));
        }

        if (pkg.rewardParts.length > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${pkg.rewardParts.join(' + ')}`));
        }
      }
    } else {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(' 暂无套餐上架'));
    }

    md.addNewline();

    md.addBold('🎐 限时活动充值');
    md.addNewline();

    if (result.activityPackages.length > 0) {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('活动套餐为临时套餐，仅有奖励和VIP经验。'));

      for (const activity of result.activityPackages) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${activity.eventTitle} - ${activity.subTitle}`));

        for (const pkg of activity.packages) {
          md.addBlockquote(
            addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`档${pkg.tierLevel}：${pkg.yuan}¥${pkg.limitText}`), [
              { label: '购买', command: `/活动充值购买 ${activity.subActivityId} ${pkg.tierLevel}` }
            ])
          );

          if (pkg.rewardParts.length > 0) {
            for (const rewardPart of pkg.rewardParts) {
              md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${rewardPart}`));
            }
          } else {
            md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('暂无奖励配置'));
          }

          md.addNewline();
        }
      }
    } else {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('当前没有进行中的活动临时充值套餐'));
    }

    md.addNewline();

    md.addBold('🌸 赞助');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(
      Format.createMarkdown()
        .addText(result.benefitView.sponsorIntro)
        .addNewline()
        .addText(`当前累计：${result.sponsor.totalYuan}元，距离主题权限还差${result.sponsor.remainingYuan}元`)
        .addNewline()
        .addText(`主题权限：${result.sponsor.hasThemePermission ? '已开启' : '未开启'}`)
    );

    // ── 月卡 ──
    md.addBold('📅 月卡');
    md.addNewline();

    if (result.monthCard) {
      const mc = result.monthCard.package;

      md.addBlockquote(addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${mc.name} (${mc.yuan}¥) `), [{ label: '购买', command: `/充值购买 ${mc.id}` }]));

      md.addNewline();

      if (mc.description) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${mc.description}`));
      }

      if (result.monthCard.instantRewards.length > 0) {
        md.addBlockquote(
          Format.createMarkdown()
            .addText('立即获得')
            .addNewline()
            .addText(`${result.monthCard.instantRewards.join(' + ')}`)
        );
      }

      const benefits = Format.createMarkdown().addText('月卡特权');

      for (const line of result.benefitView.monthCardPrivilegeLines) {
        benefits.addNewline().addText(line);
      }
      md.addBlockquote(benefits);
    } else {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(' 月卡暂未开放'));
    }

    md.addNewline();

    // ── 闭关卡 ──
    md.addBold('😴闭关卡');
    md.addNewline();

    if (result.seclusionPass) {
      const sp = result.seclusionPass.package;

      md.addBlockquote(addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${sp.name} (${sp.yuan}¥) `), [{ label: '购买', command: `/充值购买 ${sp.id}` }]));

      md.addNewline();

      if (sp.description) {
        md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${sp.description}`));
      }

      if (result.seclusionPass.instantRewards.length > 0) {
        md.addBlockquote(
          Format.createMarkdown()
            .addText('立即获得')
            .addNewline()
            .addText(`${result.seclusionPass.instantRewards.join(' + ')}`)
        );
      }

      const benefits = Format.createMarkdown().addText('专属权益');

      for (const line of result.benefitView.seclusionPassPrivilegeLines) {
        benefits.addNewline().addText(line);
      }
      md.addBlockquote(benefits);
    } else {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(result.benefitView.seclusionPassFallbackLine));
    }

    md.addNewline();

    if (result.firstChargePackages.length > 0) {
      md.addBold('🎁 优惠礼包');
      md.addNewline();

      for (const pkg of result.firstChargePackages) {
        md.addBlockquote(
          addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${pkg.name} (${pkg.yuan}¥${pkg.limitText}) `), [{ label: '购买', command: `/充值购买 ${pkg.id}` }])
        );

        if (pkg.description) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${pkg.description}`));
        }

        if (pkg.rewardParts.length > 0) {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${pkg.rewardParts.join(' + ')}`));
        } else {
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('暂无奖励配置'));
        }

        md.addNewline();
      }

      md.addNewline();
    }

    const access = await getBackendRealmAccess(bid);
    const visible = new Set([...access.moreVisibleCommands, ...access.foldVisibleCommands]);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '充值',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '查看活动充值', command: '/活动充值' },
          { label: '赞助', command: '/赞助' },
          ...(visible.has('/新人返利') ? [{ label: '新人返利', command: '/新人返利' }] : []),
          ...(visible.has('/我的权益') ? [{ label: '周周返利', command: '/周周返利' }] : [])
        ]
      })
    );
  } catch (err) {
    logger.error('充值信息渲染失败', err);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '充值',
        content: Format.createMarkdown().addText('⚠️ 读取充值信息失败，请稍后重试')
      })
    );
  }
});
